paragraphs: Ben Beteira. Mishnah Shabbat 16:1, 3; Pesachim 3:3, 4:3; Gittin 5:7; Avodah Zarah 1:6; Zevachim 1:3; Menachot 1:2. Maimonides’ Zera'im introduction: unqualified ben Beteira is Yehoshua. Halikhot Olam, section 187: Yehudah; Ta'anit 1 identifies Yehoshua only under pressure. He disputes Yehoshua ben Chananya, Zevachim 1; Yehudah, Mishnah Pesachim 46a, 53a. Rosh Hashanah 29, end of b: Zakkai addressed Beteira’s sons, Rashi, generation’s great men. Yonatan ben Beteira in Shemayah and Avtalyon’s time; see Yehudah ben Beteira. Humble: Bava Metzia 85, beginning of a, they surrendered leadership to Hillel, whose presidency began a hundred years before destruction. See Yehudah ben Beteira long after destruction: proves two.
